description: Source code for the 'ls-tree' command in Git, handling tree object listing with various formatting and recursion options.

methods.name: expand_objectsize
methods.description: Expands object size information for a given object ID and type, formatting it into a string buffer.

methods.name: show_recursive
methods.description: Determines if recursion should be applied based on options and pathspec.

methods.name: show_tree_fmt
methods.description: Formats and outputs tree entries according to specified format string.

methods.name: show_tree_common
methods.description: Determines whether to recurse into tree or blob based on options and object type.

methods.name: show_tree_common_default_long
methods.description: Outputs the name of a tree entry, handling null termination and relative path formatting.

methods.name: show_tree_default
methods.description: Default display of tree entries with mode, type, and abbreviated object ID.

methods.name: show_tree_long
methods.description: Displays tree entries with detailed size information.

methods.name: show_tree_name_only
methods.description: Outputs only the name of tree entries.

methods.name: show_tree_object
methods.description: Outputs only the object ID of tree entries.
